description: React component for the login page of a gym management system, supporting email/password authentication and Google Sign-In via Google Identity Services. Handles user login, Google OAuth integration, and redirects upon successful login.

methods.name: handleGoogleCredential
methods.description: Handles the response from Google Sign-In, exchanges credential for tokens, stores them, and navigates to the intended page.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: Sets up Google Identity Services script, renders Google Sign-In button, and prompts One Tap on component mount.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for email/password login, calls login function, and redirects upon success.
